summary: Loads pit crew animation data from the PITANIMS.MAS archive. Cleans up the existing pit-crew animation array, resolves the base directory from the application directory string byte_5EA438 (truncating at the last backslash), registers that directory with the string manager, opens the archive via sub_53CBC0, runs the main PitCrewAnimationLoader, closes the archive if it was opened, registers the path for string matching, and frees the temporary path copy. Returns the result of PitCrewAnimationLoader.
